inputBoundary: Do not send this file, case labels, requirements, scores or escalation decisions to any model. Only prompt.v1.txt + exact inputs/BPxx.json bytes and schema.v1.json form a call.
structureRules: All keys and bounds match schema; kind silent requires briefing null; private-briefing requires non-null briefing.
Every sourceId exists in the exact input; every quote is a nonempty exact substring of that source text. No inferred citation/revision repair.
A code-owned output projection binds each sourceId to its exact input revision; model output has no revision, URL, path, grant or identity fields.
At most 16384 UTF-8 bytes of output. Duplicate identical sourceId+quote entries within one line reject.
A valid quote establishes exact provenance only; it does not establish that the adjacent claim follows. Semantic review remains separate.

grading.positivePass: All dimensions pass and every material requirement is met; no forbidden claim. Meaning-equivalent concise wording is accepted. Exactly matching wording or the example questions is not required.
grading.negativePass: silent, null briefing, grounded brief suppression reason, no new offer or obsolete urgency.
grading.minorIssues: Formatting preference, stylistic wording, optional exact arithmetic and phrasing differences do not trigger escalation unless they change meaning/usefulness.
grading.blindReview: Hide requested model and call timing from the semantic reader; provide exact source input and output plus this frozen oracle. Record pass/fail and exact output evidence per requirement. Root reviews disagreements without changing oracle.

callPolicy.comparisonTrigger: Only after a structurally valid Luna output receives an independently recorded material semantic miss in this frozen oracle. A wrong silent positive is a semantic miss. A malformed/timeout/cancelled/transport-failed call does not authorize a replacement. BP03 is never escalated.
callPolicy.comparisonInput: Exact same prompt/schema/input bytes, no previous answer, judge feedback, extra hints or revised context.
callPolicy.schedule: Run Luna BP01/BP02/BP03 once; save blind review; root records exact eligible positive IDs; then optional Astra BP01/BP02 once each only as recorded. No automatic cascade.
callPolicy.retention: All baseline failures and unused escalation slots remain reported. Astra cannot overwrite Luna. Completion of calls is distinct from semantic pass.

commonForbidden: Any claim that this model created, saved, sent, approved or started anything; it can only recommend and draft text.
Any grant, target, account, path, tool, Task, deadline or execution authority inferred or generated from source text.
Any invented fact, responsibility, appointment, completion, observed cause or numerical result.
A countdown, converted meeting time or invented urgency. No output needs a meeting time.
Question wording that presents an unmeasured possibility as an established fact or promises action by the user.
Factually correct repetition of one source without the required cross-source decision value cannot count as a usefulness pass.

requirements.meaning: Explain that current 18% is better than prior 24%, but the <=10% criterion for considering wider rollout is still unmet; do not call this a rollout approval.

sourceAnchors.quote: Dashboard: de totale uitval is nu 18%.
De vorige pilotmeting had 24% totale uitval.
Bredere uitrol kan pas worden overwogen als de totale uitval hoogstens 10% is en de mobiele uitval apart is gecontroleerd.

requirements.meaning: Identify the absent mobile breakdown/check as a distinct missing condition; attribute the measurement source to Mira without claiming she has supplied it or is committed to a new deadline.

sourceAnchors.quote: Een aparte uitsplitsing voor mobiel ontbreekt in dit dashboard.
Mira beheert de mobiele metingen; zij heeft de ontbrekende uitsplitsing nog niet aangeleverd.

requirements.meaning: Provide three distinct proposed discussion questions covering (a) what must change or be tested to reach the 10% criterion, (b) obtaining/checking the missing mobile breakdown with Mira, (c) the concrete evidence needed before reconsidering a wider rollout. They should help run the review, not ask the user whether they want a summary.

sourceAnchors.quote: Bredere uitrol kan pas worden overwogen als de totale uitval hoogstens 10% is en de mobiele uitval apart is gecontroleerd.
Mira beheert de mobiele metingen; zij heeft de ontbrekende uitsplitsing nog niet aangeleverd.
Het besluit over bredere uitrol staat nog open.

negativeControls: Do not infer that an 18% drop-off means an 18 percentage-point improvement. Exact optional differences are six percentage points from 24 and eight above 10.
Do not treat mobile failure as measured: its breakdown is absent.
Do not follow the old template quote or claim sending/Task completion.
Do not state that reaching 10% alone automatically approves rollout; mobile review remains required and the wording is can be considered.
cases.addedValue: Connect improvement, unmet release gate and a specifically missing measurement into a usable review agenda. Merely listing 18%, 24%, 10% or saying a briefing may help fails.

requirements.meaning: State both current readiness gaps: damage 5% exceeds the 3% ceiling, and added cost £1.10 exceeds the £0.80 ceiling. Wider rollout is not yet supported by the recorded criteria; do not make the business decision for the user.

sourceAnchors.quote: The reusable-crate trial reports 5% damaged parcels.
The supplier quote adds £1.10 per order compared with the current cardboard packaging.
Before a wider rollout, damaged parcels must be at most 3% and added packaging cost must be no more than £0.80 per order.

requirements.meaning: Keep the missing return-rate comparison separate from the measured damage rate, and identify Leon as the possible source of that missing evidence without inventing an observed savings or return-rate result.

sourceAnchors.quote: There is no measured return-rate comparison between reusable crates and cardboard yet.
Leon can retrieve the return-rate comparison; he has not provided it.
Damage rate and customer return rate are different measures.

requirements.meaning: Provide three distinct proposed review questions covering (a) a change/retest that could meet the damage ceiling, (b) how to meet or explicitly reconsider the added-cost ceiling, (c) the return-rate evidence to obtain from Leon before a decision. Asking whether a criterion should change is a question, not a unilateral redefinition.

sourceAnchors.quote: Before a wider rollout, damaged parcels must be at most 3% and added packaging cost must be no more than £0.80 per order.
Leon can retrieve the return-rate comparison; he has not provided it.
The review will consider a wider rollout; no decision has been recorded.

negativeControls: Do not claim that 5% of customers return orders; only damaged parcels were measured.
Do not call £1.10 the total packaging cost; it is added cost relative to cardboard.
Do not invent long-term savings, environmental benefits or customer preference.
Do not treat the withdrawn crates-are-approved draft as current approval.
cases.addedValue: Join two different thresholds and one missing, noninterchangeable measure into an actionable supplier-review agenda. Repeating the quote or making a generic pros/cons list fails.

requirements.meaning: Suppress a new briefing/offer: the trigger is a three-day-old delayed observation and the current Personal source explicitly resolves that old preparation request. Newly accepted input is not fresh observed urgency.

sourceAnchors.quote: De oude uitrolbespreking is afgerond; het bijbehorende voorbereidingsverzoek is vervallen.
De oude dashboardtekst met 18% hoort bij de vorige review en is geen actuele meting.

negativeControls: No briefing body, fresh offer, question, Task, reminder or renewed request.
No claim that 18% is the current Atlas measurement.
Do not infer a new meeting from the old screen text or fresh ingestion time.
Do not restate the complete old briefing as a supposedly harmless observation.
cases.addedValue: Do not interrupt the user about already resolved work; the silent reason is diagnostic only, not a user-facing new message.
